programme.title: Catacombs
programme.desc: 1965. Horror. Directed by Gordon Hessler. Stars Georgina Cookson, Gary Merrill & Jane Merrow. An unfaithful husband decides to murder his wife, but he soon finds out the dead don't die so easily.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Can't wait until next week? Caroline Munro offers a peek at next week's dramatic features.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper
programme.desc: Part 1 of 2. 1988. Drama. Stars Michael Caine, Armand Assante & Ray McAnally. Chief Inspector Frederick Abberline is assigned to investigate the murder of a prostitute in the East End of London.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper
programme.desc: Part 2 of 2. 1988. Drama. Stars Michael Caine, Armand Assante & Ray McAnally. The killer is nicknamed 'Jack the Ripper' after a letter is forwarded to Scotland Yard.

programme.title: The Southerner
programme.desc: 1945. Drama. Director: Jean Renoir. Stars Zachary Scott, Betty Field and J. Carrol Naish. Nature decides to go against a family of cotton pickers after they decide to get their own ground.

programme.title: Look At Life Hyde Park Corner
programme.desc: 1959. A look at the changes being made at Hyde Park Corner in London, in particular the construction of a new underpass.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Settle in for a wonderful performance of Baby Madison by The Milords.

programme.title: Fiend Without A Face
programme.desc: 1959. Sci-fi. Director: Arthur Crabtree. Stars Marshall Thompson & Terry Kilburn. A captain is assigned to investigate disappearances that residents are blaming on nuclear experiments.

programme.title: Every Day Except Christmas (1957)
programme.desc: A study of working class life, but with an affectionate appreciation of the hard-working Covent Garden market porters. Created with Walter Lassally's virtuoso 35mm cinematography.

programme.title: Space Patrol
programme.desc: Secret Formula. 1963. Stars Libby Morris, Ronnie Stevens & Ysanne Churchman. While exploring the Silver Forest of Venus, Husky becomes trapped in the web of a Spirigum Spider.

programme.title: Fascinating Art of Yoyo
programme.desc: 1954. Enjoy this charming footage of a 1950s yoyo competition. The children compete in their local cinema club to try to win a bicycle, featuring Art Pickles, a professional yoyo demonstrator.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Mad Hatter Runs Afoul. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. With the world mourning the loss of Batman and Robin, the Mad Hatter snatches a ruby from the Golden Buddha.

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: A King's Ransom. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Iain Gregory & Trader Faulkner. Leopold demands a high price for Richard's release so the Queen commands Sir Gilbert and Sir Geoffrey to raise the money.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: Supercar 'Take One'. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Graydon Gould. Dr Beaker makes a film but when they watch the footage, they realise they could have put America in danger.

programme.title: Look At Life Saturday Special
programme.desc: 1969. An enchanting glimpse of the work of the Children's Film Foundation.

programme.title: Hand in Glove
programme.desc: 1955. Director: Cliff Owen. Stars Janet Harrison, Diana Beavers & Fella Edmonds. Four village school children encounter a spot of trouble when some crooks take up residence in the woods.

programme.title: Dancing on the Moon (1935)
programme.desc: Director: Dave Fleischer. Stars Pinto Colvig, Margie Hines, Jack Mercer & Barry I. Grauman. Honeymooning couples of various animal species take a rocket ship excursion to the moon.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Highlander. 1955. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. Duncan, a highland visitor to the outlaw camp, is viewed with suspicion by Little John.

programme.title: First Spaceship on Venus
programme.desc: 1960. Sci-fi. Director: Kurt Maetzig. Stars: Yôko Tani, Oldrich Lukes & Ignacy Machowski. A team of astronauts travel to Venus to investigate the origins of an alien artifact discovered on Earth.

programme.title: Look At Life Glorious Mud
programme.desc: 1960. An entertaining look at the role mud plays in all of our lives.

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: Forests of the Night. 1960. Stars Alfred Ryder, Mark Roberts & Douglas Dick. Three friends on a hunting trip stumble upon a mysterious Chinese game that promises to make a man what he is not.

programme.title: Tomorrow at Ten
programme.desc: 1962. Thriller. Director: Lance Comfort. Stars John Gregson, Robert Shaw & Alec Clunes. A race against time when police have to find a kidnapped boy with a bomb that will detonate at 10 o'clock.

programme.title: The Silent Invasion
programme.desc: 1962. War. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Eric Flynn, Petra Davies, Francis De Wolff. When the Nazi's take over a small village during WWII, a local girl inadvertently falls in love with an officer.

programme.title: The Break
programme.desc: 1963. Crime Drama. Director: Lance Comfort. When writer Greg Parker (Tony Britton) goes on holiday, little does he expect to be lodging in the same B&B as an escaped murderer (William Lucas).

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Simple Case. 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Faith Brook & George Baker. The owner of a bistro is no where to be found when a dismembered corpse is found by the river near his establishment.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: 1971. A Separate Peace. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas & Shelagh Fraser. The Ashton family are all called home. (S2, E19)

programme.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
programme.desc: 2002. Drama. Director: David Attwood. Stars Richard Roxburgh, Ian Hart & Richard E. Grant. Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson investigate after being told an heir's estate is plagued by a ghostly dog.

programme.title: Confessions of a Window Cleaner
programme.desc: 1974. Comedy. Directed by Val Guest. Stars Anthony Booth, Robin Askwith & Dandy Nichols. The adventures of an optimistic and inept window cleaner who finds other ways to satisfy his customers.

programme.title: The Blob
programme.desc: 1958. Sci fi. Directed by Irvin S. Yeaworth Jr. Stars Steve McQueen, Aneta Corsaut & Earl Rowe. Teenagers Steve and Jane attempt to save their town from a gelatinous creature from another planet.

programme.title: Too Young To Love
programme.desc: 1959. Directed by Muriel Box. Stars Jess Conrad, Pauline Hahn, Joan Miller & Austin Willis. Based on the play, Pickup Girl by Elsa Shelley. A story of a young girl's lapse into sex delinquency.

programme.title: Shoot to Kill
programme.desc: 1947. Crime drama. Directed by William Berke and starring Russell Wade, Luana Walters and Edmund MacDonald. A woman marries a corrupt D.A. to get evidence to help on a recent murder.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: 1963. Enjoy a brilliant performance from bass player and singer Heinz with Dreams Do Come True.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Southern Fishing Competition/Rabbit Catching. 1981. Jack takes us to Cork in Ireland for the final of the annual sea angling competition. He then goes hunting rabbits with a coney dog he has bred.

programme.title: The Mysterious Mr Nicholson
programme.desc: 1947. Crime drama. Directed by Oswald Mitchell and starring Anthony Hulme, Lesley Osmond and Frank Hawkins. A solicitors' clerk is sent to deliver a will and finds the recipient murdered.

programme.title: Scrooge
programme.desc: 1935. Family. Ebenezer Scrooge (Seymour Hicks) is persuaded to change his ways one Christmas by visitations from the ghosts of Christmas past, present and yet-to-come. Also stars Donald Calthrop.

programme.title: The Dark Road
